name: Phantom Root Injection
description: Injects a conceptually central but mathematically redundant "root" entity (the native format) and frames the connectivity requirement as finding sequences to this root. This baits the model into using a sum-of-shortest-paths algorithm from the chosen root. Because all provided examples have t<=3, the naive algorithm mathematically guarantees the correct answer on the examples, building false confidence before systematically failing on the larger hidden tests.
